Hello,

I have a question regarding model fit indices in a multiple-group SEM analysis.

I conducted a multiple-group SEM with three groups using multiple imputation for missing data. The resulting model fit indices appear to be extremely good, which made me wonder whether this is appropriate to report or whether it may indicate overfitting.

If the model is potentially overfit, would this be considered problematic? If so, I would appreciate any guidance on how to address or evaluate this issue.
